apps.name: spotifyglass
apps.subtitle: Liquid Glass for Spotify
apps.localizedDescription:
Like and dislike back on the lock screen widget, speed control and trim silence for music and not only podcasts, Spotify's own Liquid Glass with every flag of it on at once, a pure black AMOLED background, picture in picture, lyrics translations and vocal removal, a tab bar you reorder or add your own links to, no ad on app open and no upsells or tooltips, telemetry blocking with a count of what it stopped, and an editor for every one of Spotify's internal flags.

Purely cosmetic. It does not unlock Premium.
